data.long_meaning: Hemonta is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Hema’, which means ‘Goddess of wealth and prosperity’. This name is considered auspicious and is believed to bring abundance, prosperity, and good fortune. In Hindu mythology, Hemonta is a form of Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, who is worshipped for her blessings of wealth, fortune, and prosperity.
